title: Walter Koenig, who played Chekov on the original Star Trek, has died at 90
dek: Koenig played the young Russian navigator in the 1960s series and in seven films. News outlets and his representative confirmed the death on 26 October 2026.
what: Walter Koenig, the actor who played Ensign Pavel Chekov on the original Star Trek series, has died at 90. Variety, the AP and CNN reported it on 26 October 2026.

CBS News reports that his talent representative, Zachery McGinnis, announced the death, and that Koenig died at his home in North Hollywood, Los Angeles, with his daughter and niece at his side. CBS does not give a cause of death.

CBS says Koenig played Chekov on the series from 1967 to 1969 and in the first seven Star Trek films, beginning in 1979. It also lists his other work: a 1980 book, "Chekov's Enterprise"; scripts for television shows including The Incredible Hulk; guest appearances on Babylon 5; and teaching at UCLA and other schools.
CBS quotes a tribute from George Takei, who played Sulu: "Walter was more than Chekov. He was a writer, a teacher, a thoughtful man, and a loyal friend."
why: Star Trek has a large and devoted audience across generations, and the original cast is now small. News of a death spreads fast among fans, and the outlets that carry it are the same ones a wide audience follows.
next: A memorial or funeral announcement from his family or representative, if one is made.
